title: The Sentence's First Utterance

features.name: cardinal logic chip
features.desc-on-touch: the first gate. input is the question mark; output is the period. between them, the sentence learns to speak

features.name: songline trace routing
features.desc-on-touch: circuit paths that map onto known country. when you run your finger along the trace, you hear song-words in languages older than writing

features.name: contact field
features.desc-on-touch: the power plane. everywhere you look, gold pins hold the sentence to ground. it cannot float; it must be spoken into the world

features.name: recursion capacitor
features.desc-on-touch: it charges with voltage; it discharges by becoming a smaller copy of itself. each iteration, the sentence forgets one fewer word

features.name: origin junction
features.desc-on-touch: here the forward traces meet the backward traces. the sentence arrives at its beginning and cannot remember how to leave

inscription: no word was ever the first word; every utterance arrives already corrupted by its own echo
